pages.text: Techniques and Domains can only be obtained by rolling cores through the Ritual, but they can be $(bold)transferred and modified$() between cores using TConstruct's $(bold)modifier crystal$() mechanic.$(br2)$(bold)Removal$(): in the $(bold)Modifier Worktable$(), place a Curse Core together with a $(bold)wet sponge$() and a $(bold)sky slime crystal$() (for a Technique) or a $(bold)lumin slime crystal$() (for a Domain), then choose $(bold)Remove Technique / Remove Domain$():$(li)removes one Technique or Domain trait$(li)$(bold)returns 1 corresponding slot$() (Technique slot / Domain slot)$(li)produces a $(bold)modifier crystal$() recording that trait$(br2)Note: Techniques and Domains $(bold)cannot$() be washed off directly with an ordinary wet sponge — you must use the matching crystal to remove them.

$(bold)Applying / Transferring$(): at the tool station, place the Curse Core and a crystal carrying a Technique or Domain:$(li)consumes 1 crystal and 1 corresponding slot to install that Technique / Domain on the core$(li)ordinary materials cannot add Techniques or Domains — only crystals or the Ritual can$(br2)$(bold)Example workflow$(): strip an unwanted Technique from core A into a crystal (refunds 1 slot) → apply the crystal to core B (occupies 1 slot) → the Technique has been transferred from A to B.$(br2)Techniques and Domains $(bold)only ever originate from the Ritual$(); transferring creates no new traits.
